product_context: CitySocial is a modular-monolith social platform for city residents (currently Austin), built as one Rails app whose features live as near-independent modules (mountable engines) under components/. platform_core owns identity (User), the Follow social graph, a public Graph API, and an event bus; feed is the reference module (posts + timeline); communities is subreddit-style (join, post, comment, up/down vote); marketplace is classified listings with photos; restaurants is head-to-head Elo ranking of local spots. Users are residents who follow each other and engage through these modules. 'Better' means tightening the existing engagement loops (do -> others see it -> they get notified/react), filling in missing empty/loading/error and accessibility states on views that already ship, and polishing the UX of already-shipped modules. It does NOT mean speculative net-new features nobody asked for. Every view must compose the PlatformCore::Ui components and Tailwind v4 design tokens (no hand-rolled markup, no hardcoded hex). Modules may depend only on platform_core and must cross boundaries only via events or a sibling's app/public API (Packwerk enforces this).
out_of_scope: Anything touching auth, authorization, sessions, or payments
Standing up a whole new module (that is the human-run /new-app-module flow)
Cross-module references that violate the Packwerk boundary contract
Editing the @theme design tokens or the standalone Tailwind build config

items.title: Add empty state to the restaurants leaderboard
items.problem: The leaderboard renders a bare header-only table when there are no restaurants, unlike every other index view which shows an empty state.
items.evidence: components/restaurants/app/views/restaurants/leaderboard/index.html.erb:9 — TableComponent iterates @restaurants with no any? guard; Restaurants::Restaurant.ranked (restaurant.rb:5) is an unfiltered order, so a fresh install shows a bare table.
acceptance: With zero restaurants, /restaurants/leaderboard renders a PlatformCore::Ui::EmptyState instead of an empty table
The empty state composes shared UI components and design tokens with a CTA back to matchups
When restaurants exist, the ranked table renders exactly as before
Covered by a request spec asserting the empty-state copy renders with zero restaurants

items.title: Give icon-only vote buttons accessible labels
items.problem: The upvote/downvote controls are icon-only glyphs with no accessible name, so screen readers announce only the raw arrow character.
items.evidence: components/communities/app/views/communities/posts/_vote.html.erb:4,8 — ButtonComponent renders the up (▲) and down (▼) glyphs, and PlatformCore::Ui::ButtonComponent has no way to pass an aria-label.
acceptance: PlatformCore::Ui::ButtonComponent accepts an optional aria_label: and renders it as aria-label on all three branches (plain <button>, link, button_to button); when omitted, no aria-label attribute is emitted.
The upvote and downvote buttons in the vote partial expose aria-label="Upvote" and aria-label="Downvote" to assistive tech.
The /design catalog documents the new aria_label: option.
Component specs cover aria-label rendering on each branch and its omission when not given.

items.title: Add a post composer to the Feed index
items.problem: The feed (the app's root page) shows posts but gives a logged-in user no UI to write one; the create action and route exist but nothing renders a form.
items.evidence: components/feed/app/views/feed/posts/index.html.erb has no form/new-post button; feed/posts_controller.rb:9 defines create and config/routes.rb exposes POST /feed/posts, but no view links to it — a dead-end engagement loop on root ('/' redirects to /feed).
acceptance: Logged-in users see a composer (a PlatformCore::Ui Card with a body text_area + submit) at the top of the feed
Submitting a non-empty body creates a Feed::Post and shows it in the feed
Submitting a blank body is rejected gracefully with a flash, not a 500 (controller uses create! today)
Covered by a feed request spec (none exists yet)

items.title: Empty state for the restaurants leaderboard
items.problem: When no restaurants are ranked yet, the leaderboard renders a bare header and an empty table instead of an empty state.
items.evidence: components/restaurants/app/views/restaurants/leaderboard/index.html.erb:10 — @restaurants.each fills a TableComponent with no zero-case branch (leaderboard_controller.rb:6).
acceptance: An empty leaderboard renders PlatformCore::Ui::EmptyStateComponent instead of an empty table.
A populated leaderboard is unchanged.
A request spec covers the empty case.

items.title: Give community vote buttons accessible names
items.problem: Up/down vote buttons render only the glyphs '▲'/'▼' with no accessible name, so screen readers cannot announce their purpose.
items.evidence: components/communities/app/views/communities/posts/_vote.html.erb:4,8 — ButtonComponent content is a bare glyph; button_component.rb:24 has no aria-label/label param, so the component must be extended to pass an accessible name through.
acceptance: Upvote/downvote controls expose an accessible name (e.g. aria-label 'Upvote' / 'Downvote')
PlatformCore::Ui::ButtonComponent supports passing an accessible label without breaking existing call sites
Design catalog (/design) still renders and the button variants are unchanged visually
Covered by a component or request spec asserting the accessible name is present
items.title: Empty state for the restaurants admin index
items.problem: The admin 'All restaurants' table has no zero-case; a fresh install with no restaurants shows an empty table under the count (0).
acceptance: An empty admin restaurants list renders an EmptyStateComponent.
A populated list is unchanged.
A request or component spec covers the empty case.

items.title: Remove N+1 author lookup in the feed timeline
items.problem: Rendering the timeline issues one User query per post because each post resolves its author individually.
items.evidence: components/feed/app/models/feed/post.rb:6-8 — #author calls PlatformCore::Graph.user(author_id) (graph.rb:15-17 does User.find_by per call); feed/posts/index.html.erb:8 calls post.author&.handle inside the @posts loop → N+1. A fix likely needs a batch Graph.users(ids) public API method.
acceptance: Rendering the feed for N posts issues O(1) user queries, not O(N)
Author handles still render correctly for every post
A new batch accessor (if added) lives in platform_core app/public and does not violate Packwerk
Covered by a spec asserting the query count does not grow with post count
items.title: Make the feed compose action reachable from the UI
items.problem: feed posts#create is implemented and routed but nothing in the UI links to or renders a compose form, so a user cannot create a feed post.
items.evidence: components/feed/config/routes.rb:2 + components/feed/app/controllers/feed/posts_controller.rb:9 implement create; no view renders a compose form or 'new post' link posting to /feed.
acceptance: A logged-in user can reach a compose form and create a feed post from the feed UI.
The new post appears in the timeline and the feed.post_created event still fires.
A request spec covers create-from-UI.

items.title: Remove N+1 author lookups on post/comment lists
items.problem: Rendering post and comment lists issues one PlatformCore::Graph.user query per row because author is resolved individually, with no batch preload.
items.evidence: components/feed/app/views/feed/posts/index.html.erb:5-8, components/communities/app/views/communities/communities/show.html.erb:23-37, components/communities/app/views/communities/posts/show.html.erb:44-51 — author via PlatformCore::Graph.user per row; PlatformCore::Graph has no batch users(ids) API.
acceptance: PlatformCore::Graph exposes a batch lookup (e.g. users(ids)) in its app/public API.
Feed and communities list views resolve authors via a single preloaded query instead of one-per-row.
A spec asserts the reduced query count (or the batch API) on a multi-row list.
